key.decision_why: The author reports fixed tests on a PR that a maintainer labeled not ready, so the triager needs a short update, but the approach and files are unchanged and a new card isn't warranted.
key.action_why: laurynmm replied asking for precise before/after screenshots per the guidelines, then said the styling change needs a #design discussion, and the PR kept "not ready".
changed: The author says the failing tests are fixed.
The author pushed twice since the label, taking the PR from +12/-5 to +15/-5 in the same 3 files with the same two commits.
still_missing: The screenshots are not precise before/after pairs as the visual-changes guidelines require; they show only the current state and some freehand crops.

The PR changes the text styling (replaces `font-variant: all-small-caps` with `text-transform: uppercase` and a smaller font size), which the issue didn't ask for, and there is no #design discussion of it.
The PR doesn't respond to Karl Stolley's #design advice to use flexbox or grid and to wrap the label text in a DOM element.
CI status can't be confirmed (check runs unavailable), so the test fix is unverified.
key.reply_ask: Ask the author to add precise before/after screenshots following the presenting-visual-changes guidelines and to start a #design discussion about changing the small-caps text styling.

must_have.fact: Says precise before/after screenshots, per the visual-changes guidelines, are still missing from the PR.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and giving more feedback rather than handing off to a reviewer.
Notes the PR changes the button text styling (all-small-caps replaced by uppercase with a smaller font size) beyond what issue #38844 asks, and this needs a #design discussion on chat.zulip.org.
Says the author only reported fixing failing tests and CI status is unknown, so the fix can't be confirmed.
Mentions the existing #design thread where Karl Stolley advised using flexbox or grid with the label as its own DOM element, and that #39694 is another open PR for the same issue.
